query: A 68-year-old woman is brought to the emergency room because of pain in her right shoulder after falling down the stairs in her apartment. She has a history of postmenopausal osteoporosis. Her current medications are alendronate, vitamin D, and calcium supplementation. Physical examination shows shortening of the right arm as well as tenderness and swelling over the right shoulder. The range of motion of the right arm is limited by pain. An x-ray of the right shoulder shows a fracture of the surgical neck of the humerus. Which of the following movements is most likely to be impaired in this patient?
